{"subject":"Recap: claims file demo and next steps","body":"Hi Owen and Lily,

Thanks for making time today, and sorry about the screen share hiccup. Owen, sorry we lost you early. Here is where things stand.

Shown: your claims file loaded into the sandbox, partitioned by state, with ingest in about six minutes on the default setup. Schema was checked against your data dictionary. Twelve rows failed the date format check.

Open:
- Owen: please confirm whether paid amount and allowed amount should be numbers. They are text for now.
- Lily: you offered to send your list of failed rows so Priya can compare it with our twelve.
- Owen: we would value your view on whether the summary view is what you had in mind.

Priya is sending the twelve failed rows and a short note on the two text columns today.

Owen, what would you like to see from this evaluation, in your words? And could you share a couple of times to finish the walkthrough? I will reach out separately.
